Prince also opened up about concerns regarding inaccuracies in the film, family reactions, and the touching story behind the special armband Jaafar wore at the Los Angeles premiere. Made from fabric from Michael Jackson’s iconic red corduroy shirt, the tribute brought back powerful childhood memories for Prince.

snippet.title: Prince Jackson in Tears as Jaafar Transforms Into Michael Jackson  Heartbreaking Family Reveal
snippet.description:
Prince Jackson in Tears as Jaafar Transforms Into Michael Jackson | Heartbreaking Family RevealNearly 17 Years Later – A Family Story ReignitesSeventeen years after the heartbreaking loss of Michael Jackson, his family is once again at the center of global attention. This time, it’s not just about the music—it’s deeply personal. Fans worldwide are flocking to theaters for Michael, the highly anticipated biopic of the King of Pop. But behind the nostalgia and spectacle lies a raw family moment now making headlines.In a rare interview with ABC News, Prince Jackson—the eldest son of Michael—opened up about what it felt like to watch his cousin, Jaafar Jackson, step into his father’s shoes. For Prince, the experience was far more emotional than anyone expected. He described it as an “emotional shock,” admitting that seeing someone look so much like his father after nearly two decades was almost overwhelming.Legacy and MisunderstandingMichael Jackson’s legacy has always been complicated. His artistry reshaped pop culture, yet his life was shadowed by controversy and relentless media scrutiny. Prince believes this film matters because it can show the world a side of his father that headlines never captured—the struggles, the humanity, and the emotional battles behind the fame.The Transformation That Stopped TimePrince recalled the first time he saw Jaafar fully transformed into Michael on set. After nearly 17 years without seeing his father, the resemblance was so uncanny it felt like time froze. He fought back tears, describing it as a moment that shook him to his core.The emotional weight deepened at the Los Angeles premiere when Jaafar wore an armband crafted from Michael’s iconic red corduroy shirt. For Prince, that shirt carried childhood memories of comfort and love—his father often wore it during their hugs. That tribute went viral, with fans calling it one of the most touching gestures ever made to honor Michael.Family Tensions Behind the ScenesWhile Prince supports the film, he admitted he wasn’t heavily involved in production decisions. He raised concerns about certain “fantasy land” elements in the script, suggesting that some moments may have been softened for entertainment rather than truth. Rumors of disagreements—particularly involving Paris Jackson—have fueled speculation about how accurately the film portrays Michael’s life.Impact Beyond the Box OfficeDespite creative tensions, Prince hopes the film helps audiences rediscover Michael’s genius while also seeing the man behind the icon. For longtime fans, it’s a chance to relive the magic. For younger generations, it’s an introduction to a performer who changed music forever.Early reviews praise Jaafar’s uncanny transformation, with industry insiders already predicting award buzz. Box office analysts believe Michael could break records, driven by global curiosity and the emotional family connection.A Son’s PerspectiveFor Prince, however, this is not about numbers or accolades. It’s about preserving his father’s legacy and reminding the world that behind the superstar was a dad whose hugs, clothes, and presence still carry meaning nearly two decades later. His vulnerability in speaking out has struck a chord with fans, proving that this film is more than a biopic—it’s a family reckoning with memory, truth, and love.And for Prince Jackson, watching Jaafar become Michael wasn’t just cinema. It was like seeing his father all over again.The highly anticipated biopic "Michael" highlights the journey of the "king of pop" from child star to global icon. Jaafar Jackson's portrayal of his uncle, Michael Jackson, has impressed viewers, especially his recreation of iconic moments. snippet.title: Prince Jackson Wore MJ’s REAL Crown Pin at Tokyo Michael Movie Premiere! 👑🇯🇵
snippet.description:
During the Tokyo premiere of the Michael biopic, Prince Jackson shared a deeply personal story behind his wardrobe choice.

While he wore a custom suit with Michael Jackson’s iconic red armband in Berlin and Los Angeles, he chose something different for Japan. After the film reached incredible milestone success, Prince decided to wear an actual personal crown pin that belonged to his father, Michael Jackson 👑❤️

"Seeing as how the film has done so well... The King’s back on top, and so I wanted to switch it up, have a crown. This pin was my father's... a nice way to have a piece of him with me out here in Tokyo." — Prince Jackson 🕊️

A subtle yet beautiful way to keep Michael’s spirit alive on the global stage!
